posts.text: Not sure why "Blue Moon" is in the name. There's a photo of this exact one online from the New England Dahlia Society, and it was hybridized in Rhode Island as part of a "Bay State" series. But if you do an image search for the name you will see endless, ridiculous AI slop of imaginary blue flowers.
posts.summary: Criticizes AI-generated image spam flooding search results
